cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(color_hsla_fixture C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
get_filename_component(source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT CUI_LIBRARY)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Supply a matching CUI_LIBRARY")
endif()
add_library(hsla_primitives STATIC ${source}/src/base/cui_color_hsla.c)
target_include_directories(hsla_primitives PUBLIC ${source}/include)
target_compile_options(hsla_primitives PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
target_link_libraries(hsla_primitives PUBLIC m)
add_library(hsla_entry STATIC ${source}/src/base/cui_color_hsla_entry.c ${source}/src/components/cui_color_hsla_entry.c)
target_compile_options(hsla_entry PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
target_link_libraries(hsla_entry PUBLIC hsla_primitives ${CUI_LIBRARY} m)
enable_testing()
foreach(name color_hsla color_hsla_model color_hsla_entry color_hsla_entry_owner)
 add_executable(test_${name} ${source}/tests/unit/test_${name}.c)
 target_compile_options(test_${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
 if(name STREQUAL "color_hsla")
  target_link_libraries(test_${name} PRIVATE hsla_primitives)
 else()
  target_link_libraries(test_${name} PRIVATE hsla_entry)
 endif()
 add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND test_${name})
endforeach()
target_link_options(test_color_hsla_model PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=malloc -Wl,--wrap=calloc -Wl,--wrap=realloc)
add_executable(test_color_hsla_entry_header ${source}/tests/unit/test_color_hsla_entry_header.cpp)
target_compile_options(test_color_hsla_entry_header PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
target_link_libraries(test_color_hsla_entry_header PRIVATE hsla_entry)
add_test(NAME color_hsla_entry_header COMMAND test_color_hsla_entry_header)
foreach(name color_entry picker picker_events input)
 add_executable(regression_${name} ${source}/tests/unit/test_${name}.c)
 target_compile_options(regression_${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
 target_link_libraries(regression_${name} PRIVATE hsla_entry)
 add_test(NAME regression_${name} COMMAND regression_${name})
endforeach()
